about: Addressing God as the eternal Shepherd, the prayer asks Him to look favorably upon and continually protect His flock through Felix, the martyr and supreme pontiff whom He appointed shepherd of the whole Church.

seg.tr: Eternal Shepherd, look favorably upon Your flock, and guard it with perpetual protection through blessed Felix, Your martyr and supreme pontiff, whom You appointed shepherd of the whole Church. Through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, forever and ever.

a.g: You appointed shepherd of the whole Church

ex.w003: The eternal Shepherd is the divine addressee. Felix is the distinct human shepherd appointed over the whole Church. The printed Per Dominum conclusion remains directed to the Father.
ex.w005: Placatus describes God as favorably disposed or appeased. The flock is the object of His attention and protection, not the one described as appeased.
ex.w010: Felix is a personal name. The heading identifies Pope Felix I, and the prayer honors him as martyr and supreme pontiff.
ex.w019: Whom resumes Felix as the shepherd God appointed over the whole Church. The form could also agree with the word for flock, but the appointed pastoral office and the named saint select Felix in this context.
ex.w022: God’s appointment of Felix is recalled as a completed action. The protection of the flock, in contrast, is being requested.
